passes.name: Constant folding
passes.summary: A forward dataflow analysis tracks which locals and stack slots hold known constants. Loads of constant locals become constant pushes, arithmetic on constants is evaluated with exact JVM semantics, and branches or switches on constants become plain jumps. It emits 'pop operands; push result' and leaves the clean-up to peephole.

passes.name: Peephole rewrites
passes.summary: Local rewrites over short instruction windows inside one basic block: push/pop pairs, unused pure computations, algebraic identities, strength reduction, iinc formation, store/load to dup/store, and comparisons against 0 or null.

passes.name: Dead-store elimination
passes.summary: A backward liveness analysis over local variable slots. A store to a slot that is never read again becomes a pop, and an iinc of a dead slot is deleted. Inside a try block, every slot the handler reads stays live.

passes.name: CFG simplification
passes.summary: Control-flow clean-up: jump threading through empty goto blocks, branches whose targets are identical, deleting unreachable blocks, and merging a block into its only predecessor.

rewrites.explanation: A local variable held the same known constant on every path reaching this load, so the load was replaced by pushing the constant.
rewrites.example: int a = 3; return x * a;   →   return x * 3;

rewrites.explanation: An arithmetic, shift, conversion or comparison instruction had only constant operands, so it was evaluated now (wrapping overflow, masked shift distances, IEEE floats). The operands are popped and the result pushed. Integer division by zero is never folded.
rewrites.example: CONST 3; CONST 4; IMUL   →   POP2; CONST 12 (the pops are then cancelled by peephole)

rewrites.explanation: A conditional branch compared known constants, so its outcome is fixed. It became a pop of the operands and a GOTO to the taken side; the other side may become unreachable.
rewrites.example: boolean debug = false; if (debug) {...}   →   GOTO past the block

rewrites.explanation: A switch on a known constant key became a GOTO to the matching case.
A value was pushed (constant, local load or dup) and immediately popped, so both instructions were deleted.
A side-effect-free operation's result was discarded, so the operation was replaced by popping its inputs. Division and remainder are excluded because they can throw.
rewrites.example: ILOAD 0; CONST 7; IMUL; POP   →   ILOAD 0; CONST 7; POP2   →   (nothing)

rewrites.explanation: An operation with an identity operand was removed or simplified: x+0, x-0, x|0, x^0, x*1, x/1, x&-1, shifts by 0 (after masking), x*0 → 0, x&0 → 0, x|-1 → -1, x*-1 → -x, double negation, double swap, and iinc by 0.
A local was loaded and stored straight back into the same slot, which changes nothing.
A value stored to a local and immediately loaded again is kept on the stack with dup instead. If the store later turns out dead, dse and peephole remove it, which adds up to copy propagation.
i = i + k (load, push constant, add or subtract, store to the same int local) became one iinc instruction.
A multiplication by a power of two became a left shift.
rewrites.example: ILOAD 0; CONST 8; IMUL   →   ILOAD 0; CONST 3; ISHL

rewrites.explanation: A comparison against the constant 0 (or null) became the dedicated single-operand branch.
Liveness analysis found a store whose value is never read again on any path, so the store became a pop (or an iinc of a dead local was deleted).
rewrites.example: int unused = x * 7;   →   ...; POP   (then removed by peephole)

rewrites.explanation: A jump targeted an empty block that only jumps on, so it now goes straight to the final target.
rewrites.example: GOTO B3, B3: GOTO B7   →   GOTO B7

rewrites.explanation: A conditional branch had the same block as both targets, so it became a pop and a GOTO.
rewrites.example: IFEQ B4 else B4   →   POP; GOTO B4

rewrites.explanation: Every case of a switch went to the same block, so it became a pop and a GOTO.
rewrites.example: SWITCH { 1: B2, default: B2 }   →   POP; GOTO B2

rewrites.explanation: No path from the method entry (normal or exceptional) reaches these blocks any more, so they were deleted.
A block ending in GOTO was the only predecessor of its target, so the two were joined into one block.
